_comment: Reusable synthetic WORK-ONLY Gmail + Calendar dataset for ThreadLinePMA. Content is limited to work: projects, tasks, team meetings, manager 1:1s, conferences, work training, project discussions/differing opinions, and interview panels. It deliberately EXCLUDES job applications, job alerts, and personal events. Dates are RELATIVE (days_ago / days_from_now) so the demo always looks current. Loaded into source_items via load_demo_data.py — the same write path Stage 1 uses. All addresses/content are fictional.

gmail_messages.subject: Payments service migration — proposed plan
gmail_messages.body: Team, here is the proposed plan to migrate the payments service to the new platform. Decision to make: big-bang cutover vs. a phased rollout. Action items: Xu to draft the migration runbook; Lena to scope the integration tests. Let's align at the design review.

gmail_messages.subject: Re: Payments service migration — concerns about the timeline
gmail_messages.body: I disagree with a big-bang cutover — the risk to live transactions is too high. I'd strongly prefer a phased rollout behind a feature flag, starting with read traffic. Happy to walk through the tradeoffs at the review.

gmail_messages.subject: Re: Payments service migration — decision + action items
gmail_messages.body: Summary from today: we agreed on a phased rollout behind a feature flag. Action items: Xu to write the migration runbook by Aug 21; Lena to add integration tests by Aug 22; Sam to set up the feature flag. Next checkpoint at the weekly sync.

gmail_messages.subject: Agenda for our weekly 1:1
gmail_messages.body: For our 1:1: let's cover the payments migration status, your growth goals for the quarter, and any blockers. Please add anything you'd like to discuss to the shared doc beforehand.

gmail_messages.subject: Q3 roadmap — please review priorities
gmail_messages.body: Draft Q3 roadmap attached. Please review the proposed priorities and leave comments before the planning meeting. Action required: rank your top three items.

gmail_messages.subject: Re: Q3 roadmap — I'd reprioritize observability
gmail_messages.body: Different take: I think observability should be above the new dashboard work. We keep getting paged without good traces. Would love to debate this at planning.
